items.title: Library supplement: Even moments from a subgaussian MGF

source.anchor: Moment statement M1 and cosh/integrability/MGF/scaling steps P1–P4 in source-only.json.
source.attribution: Original exposition of a standard consequence of subgaussian exponential control; no novelty or primary-textbook completion claim.

items.statement: Let \((\Omega,\mathcal F,\mu)\) be a probability space, \(X:\Omega\to\mathbb R\), and \(c\ge0\). Suppose that, for every real \(t\), \(e^{tX}\) is integrable and \(\mathbb E_\mu e^{tX}\le e^{ct^2/2}\). For every integer \(m\ge0\), the absolute moment \(|X|^{2m}\) is integrable and satisfies the bound below.
assumptions: \(\mu\) is a probability measure on an arbitrary measurable space; no topology on \(\Omega\) is required.
The two-sided MGF condition holds for all \(t\in\mathbb R\), including exponential integrability. The parameter \(c\) is the variance proxy in \(e^{ct^2/2}\).
\(m\in\mathbb N\) and \(c\ge0\). Both \(m=0\) and \(c=0\) are included, with natural powers using \(0^0=1\).

bindings.boundary: This is a quantitative moment consequence of the stated MGF hypothesis. It does not establish an MGF bound for an unspecified law or establish an LSI, curvature estimate, or stochastic-process construction. The factorial constant is sufficient, not claimed optimal.

assumption_deltas.source: Probability law; nonnegative variance proxy; integrable exponentials and MGF bound for every real parameter; every natural moment order including zero.
assumption_deltas.lean: IsProbabilityMeasure; c : NNReal; HasSubgaussianMGF X c mu; m : Nat. Moment integrability is a conclusion.
assumption_deltas.reason: The Mathlib predicate includes both signed exponential integrability and the identical variance-proxy convention; no regularity or moment premise is added.
